####
# RefPorts: a proxy for the Ref.Ref dictionary.
#
# Generated by fprime-dict-to-cpp.  Regenerate from the dictionary rather than
# editing, and add this directory to the build with
#
#     add_fprime_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/RefPorts")
#
# Module dependencies are derived from the FPP model, so they are not listed
# again below.  Neither are the .fppi fragments RefPorts.fpp includes:
# the build tracks them as included files already.
####

register_fprime_module(
  AUTOCODER_INPUTS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/RefPorts.fpp"
  SOURCES
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/RefPorts.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/RefPortsCommands.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/RefPortsEvents.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/RefPortsPackets.cpp"
  HEADERS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/RefPorts.hpp"
)
